title: Reading the first input tape
statement: Let $z$ be a finite bit string, let $q$ be a scan phase, and let $i$ be a natural number such that $i+1\le |z|$. If the bit of $z$ at index $i$ is $b$, then from the configuration in state $q$ with the input head at position $i+1$, arbitrary two work-tape contents, both work heads at an arbitrary integer position $j$, and empty output, one machine step moves the input head to position $i+2$ and enters the state that records phase $q$ and the read bit $b$. The work tapes, work-head positions, and output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary tape contents and work-head position $j$
